items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: but the one who stayed along with us was a boy from Philadelphia, Del Zane, Z-A-N-E.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Back to Sharky and Nick's, who else was in the band? Who was the piano player?

We had several, but the one who stayed along with us was a boy from Philadelphia, Del Zane, Z-A-N-E. It's new to me. Well he played on a radio station in Philadelphia for quite a while. What was the big station there? W-P-E-N is one. No, it is not the one, the other one. He was a staff pianist on that station for quite a while. Excellent piano player.
Did you have a bass player there?
